events.title: Annual Tree Lighting at Newark Winter Village
events.addr: Mulberry St & Edison Pl, Newark, NJ 07102
events.blurb: Downtown Newark lights its tree with kids' crafts, a World Ice Exhibition skating show, a bouncy house, Santa and DJ Scotty Nevers. Skating and other Winter Village rides are extra.
events.blurbEs: El centro de Newark enciende su árbol con manualidades para niños, una exhibición de patinaje de World Ice, un inflable, Santa y DJ Scotty Nevers. El patinaje y otras atracciones del Winter Village se pagan aparte.

events.title: Free rides on the Military Park Carousel
events.blurb: The downtown park's carousel is running for the holidays, with rides free thanks to the Newark City Parks Foundation and sponsors.
events.blurbEs: El carrusel del parque del centro funciona durante las fiestas, con viajes gratis gracias a la Newark City Parks Foundation y sus patrocinadores.

events.title: New Jersey Devils vs. Calgary Flames
events.blurb: A 1 p.m. Black Friday matinee for the Devils downtown.
events.blurbEs: Un partido de los Devils a la 1 p.m. el Black Friday, en el centro.

events.title: New Jersey Devils vs. Winnipeg Jets
events.blurb: Saturday-night NHL hockey at The Rock.
events.blurbEs: Hockey de la NHL el sábado por la noche en The Rock.

events.title: Seton Hall vs. Siena
events.blurb: Pirates men's basketball hosts Siena at Prudential Center. Tip time is still to be announced.
events.blurbEs: El baloncesto masculino de los Pirates recibe a Siena en el Prudential Center. La hora aún no se ha anunciado.

events.title: Capleton & Tarrus Riley
events.blurb: Two Jamaican reggae stars share the bill at NJPAC on Friday night.
events.blurbEs: Dos estrellas jamaiquinas del reggae comparten escenario en NJPAC el viernes por la noche.

events.title: Thanksgiving Comedy Fest
events.blurb: Bill Bellamy, Luenell, Mark Curry and Tacarra Williams headline NJPAC's holiday-weekend stand-up night.
events.blurbEs: Bill Bellamy, Luenell, Mark Curry y Tacarra Williams encabezan la noche de comedia del fin de semana festivo en NJPAC.

events.title: Rock the Bells Festival: LL Cool J, Lil’ Kim, Method Man & Redman
events.blurb: LL Cool J's hip-hop festival comes indoors for Thanksgiving weekend, with Lil' Kim, Method Man & Redman, SWV and a D-Nice set featuring The Lox.
events.blurbEs: El festival de hip-hop de LL Cool J llega bajo techo el fin de semana de Acción de Gracias, con Lil' Kim, Method Man & Redman, SWV y un set de D-Nice con The Lox.

events.title: Branch Brook Park
events.addr: Lake St & Park Ave, Newark, NJ 07104
events.blurb: Newark’s 360-acre county park with lakes, paths and the country’s largest cherry tree collection.
events.blurbEs: El parque de 145 hectáreas de Newark, con lagos, senderos y la mayor colección de cerezos del país.
